note: Extraction quality is unmeasured: sentences were picked by a regex prefilter and have not been hand-labelled, so some are not real author-stated open problems.
rate_note: ai_ml_rate is the share of all corpus papers with a stated open problem; concept_rate is not exported (see rates_by_concept). Display only: not used in any gap score or backtest.
